regions.purpose: Names the Entry by its Location and holds the Entry-level affordances — Back and Remove.
The Entry's Location — display name, coordinates, cached provider metadata — and the handoffs that act on it.

The Entry's Review, shown as the full template field set. Renders one of two states: reviewed (the user has saved data) or unreviewed (the Location is in the Collection but not yet evaluated — every field shown unset).

affordances.label: Open in an external map app

shows: the field's value, rendered for its type, or an unset marker when empty

lists.emptyState: When the Entry is unreviewed, every template field shows unset and the region prompts the user toward Edit the Review.
